text: Two white plastic wash bottles stand upright side by side on a metal plate held in an aluminium extrusion frame. Each has a red screw cap with a red angled spout; both caps are on. The left bottle has a green band and holds a clear liquid roughly to the band; the right bottle has a blue band and also holds clear liquid. Silver ball-headed pins and bolts dot the plate. Near the lower right are two small white caps or discs lying on the plate and a square black-and-white fiducial marker sticker; another marker is at the upper left of the frame. Behind is a grey bench top with a dark metal base plate and two black vertical rods, plus LED strip lighting and a dark monitor edge at left.
